# SharpSevenZip

This Mod uses SharpSevenZip 2.0.109 as the managed wrapper for `7z.dll`.

- Project and source: https://github.com/JeremyAnsel/SharpSevenZip
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/SharpSevenZip/2.0.109
- License: GNU LGPL 3.0 or later

The unmodified managed assembly is distributed separately in the Mod root. The
complete license text is copied into this directory during the build.
